LESSON: FOOD/ PRACTICES

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.5: Food/ PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Food/ PRACTICES. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when nutrition, feeding self eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Food/ PRACTICES
2. Practise Food/ PRACTICES at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food/ PRACTICES

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Food/ PRACTICES
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Food/ PRACTICES. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Food/ PRACTICES at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Food/ PRACTICES at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food/ PRACTICES
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Food/ PRACTICES. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Food/ PRACTICES using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Food/ PRACTICES in the examples.
2. Explain Food/ PRACTICES to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food/ PRACTICES.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food/ PRACTICES using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Food/ PRACTICES important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
